title: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Association v. Union of India (NJAC Case / Fourth Judges Case)

content.caseIdentity: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Association v. Union of India (NJAC Case / Fourth Judges Case), (2015) 6 SCC 1
content.holding: Struck down the 99th Constitutional Amendment and the NJAC Act as unconstitutional; held that judicial primacy in appointments forms an integral part of judicial independence and the basic structure.
content.relevance: Preserved the Collegium and invalidated legislative executive appointments commission.
